name_reason: Compliant with the data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention: data_fd2_ prefix marks a game global, chapter_ch23 is the domain with a legitimate chapter ID 23 (chapters 01-30 are meaningful IDs, NOT a Ghidra address residue -- the address is 0x522C5), end_scene_char_facing accurately describes the contents (per-character facing/direction values for the chapter-23 end scene), and the table suffix reflects the array data type. Name matches both sibling tables (pos_x @ 0x522A3, pos_y @ 0x522B4) and the surrounding chapter-table naming. The mild chapter/ch redundancy is the established cross-table convention and does not warrant a rename that would touch protos.h/globals.h/call sites.
purpose: Chapter 23 end-scene per-character facing/direction table; supplies the orientation (arg3) for the cast placed by fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro alongside the parallel pos_x/pos_y tables.
logic_summary: Read-only 17-byte byte array referenced solely by fd2_chapter_23_end. The Watcom prologue copies all 17 bytes onto a stack scratch buffer (four dwords + one trailing byte) and passes the pointer as the 3rd argument to fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro, which indexes the table by character slot to orient each placed character. Read in lockstep with pos_x @ 0x522A3 (arg1) and pos_y @ 0x522B4 (arg2). Values are uniform 0x00 (default facing) except the trailing element (index 16) which is 0x02.
element_semantics: One facing/direction code per character slot (indexed by character slot used during end-scene placement). 0x00 = default facing; the trailing element (index 16) = 0x02. Direction encoding shared with the other chapter end-scene facing tables consumed by fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro.
notes: src comment block (chend2.c lines 337-346) already accurately and concisely documents all three end-scene tables (17-byte extent, Watcom 4-dword+1-byte copy pattern, arg roles, facing values 0x00 except trailing 0x02); left untouched (no src edit, so no diff for chend2.c). Ghidra plate migrated from the deprecated PRE_COMMENT field (which held stale 'emit_action = emit_c_const' pipeline residue) into PLATE_COMMENT via run_script_inline + cu.setComment(CodeUnit.PLATE_COMMENT,...) per project_ghidra_data_plate_mechanism; stale PRE_COMMENT cleared. All three sibling tables (pos_x/pos_y/facing) and the callee fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro (shared by 15 chapter end handlers) corroborate the position+facing cast-placement triple. Zero game-side write-xref -> const. Stage 2 rename: none required.
